title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Need me to make you some midnight snacks, Boss?

title: Talk 1
original: Here you go, Boss. And this. You mentioned it before... Everyone says I have a good memory, but I don't know.

title: Talk 2
original: When I'm off… I practice cooking. Not just seafood. What do you like to eat, Boss?

title: Talk 3
original: Errr… Boss, is it usually on me to find something to talk about?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Boss, if you ever want to see a Lungmen night market, I can take you. It's fun... but not exactly safe.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Boss Lady Kal'tsit gave me special permission to use Rhodes Island's supply channels. Now I can try some new stuff. Any requests, Boss?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I had Officer Hoshiguma on me for a while, for a couple of reasons... But I know she was just looking out for me, same as the neighborhood aunties and uncles.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I've been told that with my looks, my good memory and knife skills, I was born to be a villain. I don't like that, and I've struggled to find a proper way to change myself. But after coming to Rhodes Island, I realized I should just live my own life.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Boss, do you think there's any way to put my memory to good use...? I never thought about it before, but it would be nice if I could help.

title: Idle
original: Bo... Oh, you're asleep. I'll just keep reading then.

title: Onboard
original: Hey, Boss. I'm Jaye. Officer Hoshiguma said I'd be better off working here, so here I am. I know seafood, I can cook, and I'm pretty good with a knife. I think I can help.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Oh... so cooking and warfare are pretty alike…

title: Promotion 1
original: Boss, does this mean I can expand my stall a bit more?

title: Promotion 2
original: Boss, I figured it out. If you just treat the enemy like fish, then fighting is a lot easier.

title: Added to Squad
original: I forgot to close up…

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I know how to lead a fishing crew.

title: Depart
original: Hm? We're going?

title: Begin Operation
original: That's a lot.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Yeah?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Right here.

title: Deployment 1
original: I'll try.

title: Deployment 2
original: Ughh...

title: In Battle 1
original: Scale.

title: In Battle 2
original: Gut.

title: In Battle 3
original: Clean.

title: In Battle 4
original: Slice.

title: 4-star Result
original: Boss, did we just do something special?

title: 3-star Result
original: Boss, is it... is it over?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Boss, should we go after them?

title: Operation Failure
original: Boss, I think we should probably run.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I don't know if there's a suitable place to set up my stall…

title: Tap
original: Hm?

title: Trust Tap
original: Boss, I wonder if you have any food preferences...?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: I used to always have to close up the stall late, but now all of a sudden it's a holiday. Can't say I'm used to it... Boss, you want some late-night chow? I'm a little hungry myself. I can cook something for us both.

title: Greeting
original: Hey Boss, you're looking good today.

title: Birthday
original: It's your birthday today, Boss. Big day. I always remember it, but I'm no good at presents... How about I make you something to eat? Whatever you want, I'll whip it up.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: When Officer Hoshiguma said I should come to Rhodes Island, I was ready to work my hands to the bone. Then I realized, I may not get paid as much as I thought I would, but the work's also easier than I thought, so I guess it balances out... I'll keep doing my best, Boss.
